snippet.title: UFO 50 Nonograms | Fangame Teaser
snippet.description:
UFO 50 Nonograms is a fangame of Mossmouth's UFO 50. Solve 250 UFO 50 themed Nonogram (Picross) puzzles alongside an incremental progression system!
Coming to itch io in 2026: https://m3zik.itch.io/lx-nonograms
Trailer music by: @tsk-mus1c
Original music by Eirik Suhrke
It's been 7 months in the making, but it's coming soon!
#ufo50 #picross #nonogram #fangame
